notes: This manifest is intentionally seeded with profiles only.
Add visible-light source clips under source_clips and reviewed excerpts under excerpts as color videos land in app/src/test/resources/vidcap/.
Keeping color cases in a separate manifest avoids accidentally folding them into the existing black-hot baseline suite.
